component.name: Critter
component.summary: Customizable desktop pet automation for Linux (Hyprland / Wayland)

description.p: Critter is an extensible desktop pet and automation platform designed specifically for modern Wayland compositors using GTK4 and Wayland Layer Shell.

ul.li: Multiple simultaneous animated companions (Corgi, Mochi the Cat)
Wayland Layer Shell rendering on top of windows
Event-driven automation engine with triggers and actions
Local WebSocket bridge and companion browser extension for focus guarding and tab management
Package management for validating, exporting, and installing community pet packages

description.p: Initial release featuring multi-pet engine, Layer Shell support, automation engine, browser companion bridge, and community packaging.
